behaviour.title: Replace the Twilio sender number
behaviour.detail: The from number is +15550100000, which is in the reserved fictional 555-01xx range and is not a number anyone can send from. Twilio rejects it. Put a number on your own account here, or a Messaging Service SID.

behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "ONCALL_NUMBER" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.

bindings.title: Import "lib: Post-Process Drafts" and select it on Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow
bindings.detail: This template calls a separate workflow named lib: Post-Process Drafts, and it is included in your download as lib/lib-post-process-drafts.json. Import that file into n8n first (Workflows -> Import from File), then open Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow and pick it in the workflowId selector. behaviour.title: The routed arms are not equivalent - the 'standard' arm takes no action of its own
behaviour.detail: Route by Work Type splits the run. The 'priority' arm ends at Fast-Track 'priority' + Alert, which posts a Microsoft Teams message. The 'standard' arm goes to Delegate 'standard' to Sub-workflow, which calls the included sub-workflow lib: Process Standard Task - that sub-workflow normalises the item and tags it with the route, but performs no action of its own, so the branch completes and nothing is sent, filed or updated for it. Add the handling you want inside lib: Process Standard Task before relying on that arm.
